model.name: eurollm-22b
model.about: EuroLLM-22B-Instruct (2512), from the EU-funded EuroLLM project (Unbabel, Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Edinburgh and partners). Apache-2.0. 22.6B dense, Llama architecture, BF16 as released, 45 GB: fits an A100 without FP8. Trained for all EU languages, not for SQL. With vLLM's default JSON grammar it padded finished answers with whitespace until the token limit (the first run, 2026-09-27, stopped early on 21 cut-off replies); the grammar here disallows free whitespace, as SGLang needed.

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT d.display_name, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
